Ph.D. Student, University of Macau & Great Bay University

CV Google Scholar GitHub

Hi! I am a second-year Ph.D student at GVCLab, University of Macau and Great Bay University, advised by Prof. Xiaodong Cun and Prof. Chi-Man Pun. Previously, I received my M.S. and B.Sc. degrees from Xidian University.

I am interested in multimodal agents, understanding and generation, especially multimodal agents / LLMs for game and 3D.
